dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Program ORCR0961 handles monthly business processing for disability pension/self-pay detailed file creation.
evidence: ASSIGN RECE82PARA style (GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL environment variable assignment)
JMA Open Source License copyright notice
No EXEC CICS or EXEC SQL
Fixed format with Japanese EUC comments

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA Japanese medical receipt (レセプト) processing system - monthly business processing for disability pension and self-pay detailed file creation and print data editing
purpose.summary: This program (ORCR0961) is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software system. It processes monthly medical receipt data for disability pension and self-pay patients, creating detailed files and editing print data. It reads multiple indexed files (patient insurance info, disease names, point claim totals, amount claim totals, admission/discharge history) and produces output files.

notable_features: 34 COPY statements with .INC copybooks using REPLACING
Multiple indexed sequential files with FILE STATUS
OCCURS tables for hospital/system management data
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access modes on indexed files
Large working storage with structured areas (STS, FLG, CNT, SYS, IDX, WRK)
verdict.notes: Source is encoded in EUC-JP (decoded as latin-1), causing garbled display of Japanese comments. The program is clearly part of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system used widely in Japanese medical clinics. File truncated at 16000 chars out of 150309 bytes (3493 lines total); full procedure division not visible but structural indicators confirm production-quality batch program.
